subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> is the two-angle studio reference sheet of a dark metallic red sports sedan (front three-quarter and rear three-quarter views), showing sleek coupe-like proportions, a silver star emblem on the grille and trunk, slim split LED headlights and taillights, a black mesh lower grille, black multi-spoke alloy wheels with red brake calipers, dual round exhaust tips, and dark tinted windows.
<Subject 1> is the car in <Picture 1>: the same dark metallic red sports sedan with identical body lines, badge, lighting, wheel design, and dual exhaust, now driving through a rain-slicked night city environment.
<Video 1> is a rough gray-box Blender previsualization whose exact camera path and exact object motion must be used as the literal motion source for the entire target video: every camera position, angle, movement type, movement speed, and cut timing, and every corresponding position, speed, rotation, and timing of the car itself, must be copied directly from <Video 1>'s nine-shot sequence — a low chase shot behind the car on a street, a pulled-back following shot, an overhead tracking shot along a curving road, a low tracking close-up on a spinning wheel, an extreme close-up on a foot pressing a pedal, a return to the overhead curve-tracking shot, a low orbiting side pass around the car body, an elevated three-quarter tracking shot, and a final extreme close-up on hands gripping and turning the steering wheel. Only <Video 1>'s rough gray-box visuals, flat placeholder shading, and simplified environment are replaced; its motion data is not.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video shows <Subject 1>, the dark metallic red sedan from <Picture 1>, driving fast through a rain-slicked night city. Every camera movement and every movement of the car — position, speed, rotation, and the exact cut timing between all nine shots — must be taken directly and precisely from <Video 1>, reproducing its motion frame-for-frame while replacing only its rough placeholder visuals with the photorealistic car, driver, and city environment described here.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1> (referenced throughout [Shot 1]-[Shot 9]): fully_preserved - the sedan's silhouette, star badge, lighting, wheel design, brake calipers, and dual exhaust are retained on <Subject 1> in every shot.
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]-[Shot 9]): fully_preserved - color, body design, and identity remain consistent across all nine shots.
<Video 1> (governs camera and object motion in [Shot 1]-[Shot 9]): fully_preserved - the camera's exact path, angle, movement type, movement speed, and cut timing, and the car's exact position, speed, and rotation at every moment, are copied directly and precisely from <Video 1> with no deviation; only its rough gray-box geometry, flat placeholder shading, and simplified environment/interior shapes are not reused and are replaced by the photorealistic scene.

detailed_description:
Live-action, cinematic night driving style, wet reflective asphalt, glowing neon signage, and cool blue-and-amber city lighting with strong contrast and light rain haze. Every camera move and every motion of the car below exactly follows the path, speed, and timing choreographed in <Video 1>.
[Shot 1] Exactly matching <Video 1>'s opening camera path and the car's exact starting motion, a low chase shot frames <Subject 1> from directly behind as it accelerates down a narrow night city street, its taillights and license plate glowing red against the wet road, streetlights and shopfront neon streaking past on either side at the same speed and framing as <Video 1>. [Shot 2] At 00:01.000, precisely following <Video 1>'s camera pull-back, the camera pulls back to a wider following shot as the street opens into a highway on-ramp, city lights and distant hills fading into the dark background while <Subject 1> holds the same steady high speed set by <Video 1>. [Shot 3] At 00:01.750, reproducing <Video 1>'s exact overhead trajectory, the camera cuts to a high overhead angle, tracking directly above <Subject 1> as the road curves sharply at the same rate and radius as in <Video 1>, the car's headlights carving a bright arc across the glistening curved lanes and guardrails below. [Shot 4] At 00:02.750, matching <Video 1>'s low tracking wheel shot exactly, the shot cuts to a low, close tracking angle on the rear wheel, the multi-spoke rim and red brake caliper from <Picture 1> spinning in a tight blur just above the wet pavement at the same rotational speed as <Video 1>, water spray flicking off the tire tread. [Shot 5] At 00:04.750, following <Video 1>'s pedal-close-up timing and motion precisely, the shot cuts to an extreme close-up inside the cabin: a foot in a dark shoe presses firmly down on the accelerator pedal at the exact same speed and depth of travel as in <Video 1>, the pedal sinking under the pressure as the engine note rises. [Shot 6] At 00:05.250, exactly repeating <Video 1>'s return to the overhead tracking angle, the camera follows <Subject 1> as it sweeps through another curve of the elevated night road at the identical path and speed as <Video 1>, its headlight beams sweeping across the wet asphalt. [Shot 7] At 00:06.000, matching <Video 1>'s orbiting side pass exactly, the shot cuts to a low side-profile pass, the camera orbiting close alongside <Subject 1>'s doors and wheels at the same arc speed as <Video 1> while city light reflections ripple across its glossy dark red paint. [Shot 8] At 00:07.250, exactly following <Video 1>'s elevated tracking camera path, the camera rises into an elevated three-quarter tracking shot, holding the same relative position beside the car as an illuminated city skyline glides past in the background at the identical speed as <Video 1>, its towers reflected faintly on the hood. [Shot 9] At 00:08.500, precisely matching <Video 1>'s final camera move and hand motion, the shot cuts to an extreme close-up on the steering wheel, a pair of hands gripping it firmly and turning it through the same exact motion and speed as in <Video 1>, dashboard light glowing softly across the driver's knuckles as the shot holds until the end of the video.

overall_soundscape:
A deep engine growl rises and falls with each gear change, layered under continuous tire hiss on wet asphalt and the light patter of rain. The mechanical click of the accelerator pedal is audible in its close-up, and a low exhaust burble punctuates the curves.

non_diegetic_music:
A driving, bass-heavy electronic night-drive track at a fast, steady tempo, built on a pulsing synth bassline and crisp hi-hats, sustaining energy throughout without dropping out.
